projection.event_oracle: Reuse independently cloud-validated complete original event streams and G CRC/SHA proof; do not recompute event effects from the encounter projection
projection.local_work: Original archive/member hashes, CRC, JSON identity/count projection and synthetic metadata negative controls only

statistics.Error: Never omit or replace Error; all 360 native units must declare and independently validate zero Errors before successful full computation
statistics.nullable_metric: FirstEffectiveSeconds; retain null count and pairs with either null separately
statistics.stratum_scope: Every hero/group/element/level separately, all three blocks combined; no pooled outcome comparison substituted
statistics.paired_outcomes: All 16 Purple->Orange outcome transition cells, including zero Error cells
statistics.paired_metrics: Descriptive Orange-minus-Purple paired difference distributions for every original numeric EncounterSample field, with null-pair counts; no effect thresholds
structured_fields: ControlUnionTicksByTarget: distribution per semantic target when present and present encounter count
FirstWindupIntentIndexes: individual index and exact ordered sequence frequencies
statistics.floating_representation_only: Per-unit aggregate ObservedSeconds*10 reconciliation uses absolute 1e-6 ticks for binary floating sum; original cloud oracle already validates every tick/encounter; no effect-value tolerance
statistics.guardian_duration: Long progressing Guardian encounters retain Death/Censored/observed duration; duration is not a balance failure reason

case_coverage.authority: Original formal plan and original independently validated actual case_denominators, never inferred from rounded outcome averages
case_coverage.report_scope: Every hero/group/element/level and each arm, sum exactly three full blocks

cloud_isolation.output: owned /dev/shm, bounded 64 MiB; persist only after root floor and byte guards
cloud_isolation.other_active_jobs: Defer startup for resources; never stop cap/render jobs
cloud_isolation.owned_cleanup: Only after authoritative stopped container/systemd and complete G archive/member proof
